_doc: Latest minimum wage figures Saathi can show. Read by backend/app/services/work_rules.py minimum_wage(). RULES: a figure is only 'verified': true when it was read from an official government document; anything seen only in news or compliance sites is 'verified': false and the UI says 'may be'. Nothing is invented: where no usable figure was found, per_month is null. Minimum wages are set by the state (the Centre sets only a floor wage, s.9 Code on Wages, 2019) and revised for dearness twice a year (1 April and 1 October under the Code on Wages Central Rules, 2026; Maharashtra notifies for Jan-Jun and Jul-Dec). Re-check before every release.

central_floor_wage.note: Code on Wages, 2019 s.9 lets the Centre fix a floor wage that no state minimum wage may go below. No notified national floor wage figure was found on official sites on the checked_on date (news in 2026 says the Centre is still working on it). Do not show one.

sources.title: Code on Wages, 2019, section 9 (floor wage) and section 5 (no wage below the minimum)

uttar pradesh.name: Uttar Pradesh
uttar pradesh.verification_note: Figures come from news reports of the Labour Department (Shram Vibhag) order dated 21 Oct 2026; the order itself on uplabour.gov.in could not be opened from our network (connection reset), so these are NOT verified against the official order. Daily rate = monthly / 26 as the order is reported to say.
uttar pradesh.structure: One rate per skill level, by area: (a) Gautam Buddh Nagar and Ghaziabad, (b) other municipal corporation districts, (c) all other districts. Saathi uses the lowest area so a warning is only shown when pay is below the lowest rate in the state.
uttar pradesh.notification: Uttar Pradesh Labour Department government order (shasanadesh), revision of minimum wage and variable dearness allowance for 1 Oct 2026 to 31 Mar 2027 (order number not seen)

sources.title: Uttar Pradesh Labour Department (Shram Vibhag), minimum wage and dearness allowance order
sources.publisher: Labour Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh

sources.title: News report of the 21 Oct 2026 order with the new rates (28 Oct 2026)

uttar pradesh.earlier: Rates were also raised from 1 April 2026 after protests in Noida (All India Radio report, 15 Apr 2026: https://newsonair.gov.in/up-govt-raises-wages-for-unskilled-semi-skilled-skilled-workers/). The 1 Oct 2026 revision replaces them.

maharashtra.name: Maharashtra
maharashtra.verification_note: Maharashtra has NO single unskilled/semi-skilled/skilled rate. The Commissioner of Labour notifies a separate monthly minimum wage (basic + special allowance) for each scheduled employment (for example motor repair workshops, bakeries, cotton ginning, textile dyeing and printing, shops, advocates' offices) and each of 3 circles (Parimandal 1, 2, 3), twice a year. The official notification for 1 Jan to 30 Jun 2026 (dated 4 Feb 2026) was opened but is a handwritten-digit scan we cannot transcribe reliably, and the Jul-Dec 2026 notification (dated 5 Aug 2026, ref. P.V./K.V.A./V.Bh. July-December/2026 (2)/Work-10/7997) was seen only through a compliance-site summary. So no state-wide figure is stored and minimum_wage('maharashtra') returns None.
maharashtra.structure: per scheduled employment x circle (1, 2, 3) x skill (skilled, semi-skilled, unskilled)
maharashtra.notification: Office of the Commissioner of Labour, Maharashtra: revised minimum wages (variable dearness / special allowance) 1 Jul to 31 Dec 2026, under the Minimum Wages Act, 1948 as continued by Code on Wages, 2019 s.69(2)

example_unverified.note: Secondary summary of the 5 Aug 2026 notification; one example only, never use it as a general figure.
